title: BlueLinx to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results Conference Call and Webcast on August 5, 2026
summary: BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, will issue second quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Tuesday, August 4, 2026. A conference call to discuss the Company’s results will be hosted by Shyam Reddy, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Kelly Wall, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET. A webcast of the conference call and accompanying presentation materials will be available in the Investor Relations section of the BlueLinx website at https://investors.bluelinxco.com , and a replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the webcast is complete.
